title: Why NO union/Chernoff bridges average->worst on the line family: MDS first moment <<n, so the floor is a measure-zero outlier (witness spread exponentially rare)
reduced_to: The correct surviving statement: the line-family AVERAGE (first/second moment) is provably blind to the worst-case B = max_{b!=0}||eta_b|| (the generalized-Paley non-principal eigenvalue / BGK object), so any Chebyshev/Chernoff/union argument over the n^2-monomial-line family bounds only the mean and cannot certify the delta* floor. The floor IS the worst-case tail (to order ~log n moments) = the deep-moment input E_r(mu_n), which is exactly the open BGK/Paley core (face-3). No new bridge; the meta-claim correctly identifies WHY concentration fails but does not advance past the wall.
wall: W-BGK / W-Paley (the worst-case B = sub-sqrt-q incomplete character sum over the thin dyadic subgroup; the tail/deep-moment E_r(mu_n) is the open 25-year core). Also touches W-Johnson (the explicit single-line ceiling lives only at capacity-1/n, never reaches the open INTERIOR window).
evidence: Exact-integer probes on PROPER dyadic subgroup primes mu_n < F_q* (n=8 q=1009 beta=3.33; n=16 q=7681; n=32 q=12289; n=64 q=65537; n=8/16 q=65537 beta=5.3/4.0; n=32 q~2^30 beta=6.0; n<<sqrt q). Files: scripts/probes/_407_conn/C047_avg_vs_worst_line.py, C047_family_maxavg.py. VERIFIED clauses: (i) the cited line_first_moment_bound IS in tree and proven (LineFirstMomentBound.lean, M*a<=|C|*n, axiom-clean) and the explicit spreads n-1 and (k+1)(n-k-1)+1=Theta(n^2) ARE in tree (MCANearCapacityLowerBound/SharpSpread.lean). (ii) the average over the monomial line family is genuinely tiny: at an INTERIOR radius (rho=1/4, delta=(johnson+cap)/2=0.625, a_thr=n-floor(delta n)) the per-line total list-incidence avg_I=0.43,0.38,0.35 for n=8,16,32 with max_I=1 and a first-moment ceiling |C|n/a~2.7e3..3.3e4 that is MASSIVELY loose (~1e4x) vs the realized max -- so yes, worst >> average and the second-moment ceiling carries no useful information about the worst line. (iii) MDS first moment E_line[I]=q^{k+1}V_{delta n}/q^n collapses with n (10^{+1.7},10^{0.0},10^{-3.9},10^{-16.3} for n=8,16,32,64) -- confirmed astronomically below the floor target. REFUTED clauses (this is why PARTIAL not OPEN): (a) the TITLE/anchor claim 'explicit constructions cap at Theta(n^2)/q << eps*' is ARITHMETICALLY WRONG in the prize regime: at the true prize n=2^30, eps*=2^-128, the Theta(n^2)~2^57.6 spread gives eps_realized=2^-100 (q~n*2^128), 2^-62 (q~n^4), 2^-92 (q~n^5) -- ALL strictly ABOVE eps*=2^-128, i.e. spread > q*eps* (floor) in every prize sub-regime (2^57.6 vs 2^30/2^-8/2^22). The small-q test rows falsely read 'spread<floor=False' only because literal q*eps*~1e-35 there; the honest prize-regime computation in the EXTRAP block shows the spread is ABOVE, not 'astronomically below', the floor budget. (b) 'max/avg -> infinity / witness spread EXPONENTIALLY rare': the exact family ratio is mild and slow -- max/avg = 2.33, 2.65, 2.82 for n=8,16,32 (per-scalar single-codeword multiplicity ratio = exactly 2.0), consistent with ~log n / sqrt n growth, NOT exponential. The maximizer is rarer than average but only POLYNOMIALLY so.
honest_note: Genuine kernel, correctly read from the three source files: (1) line_first_moment_bound and the explicit Theta(n^2) spread are real in-tree objects; (2) the structural observation that the line-family AVERAGE (first/second moment) provably governs only the mean and is blind to the worst case, so no Chebyshev/Chernoff/union argument can bridge average->worst-case, is SOUND and matches the established campaign walls (C045 'avg blind to B', the deep-moment KB notes, face-3 of the open core). That meta-insight is the surviving PARTIAL content and it correctly welds to BGK/Paley. What is REFUTED, with exact prize-regime arithmetic, is the connection's specific quantitative anchor: the explicit Theta(n^2) single-line spread does NOT sit 'astronomically below eps*' -- in every prize sub-regime (q~n*2^128, n^4, n^5) it gives eps_mca ABOVE eps*; the reason it fails to pin delta* is NOT magnitude-vs-budget but RADIUS LOCATION (the spread lives only at delta=1-(k+1)/n = capacity-1/n, the very TOP of the window, never the open interior (1-sqrt rho, 1-rho-Theta/log n)), and the 'exponentially rare' / 'max/avg->infinity' rate is overstated (exact ratio grows ~2->2.8, polynomially). So C047 is a correct WHY-no-concentration meta-observation wrapped around a false magnitude/rate claim; it restates the BGK wall rather than advancing it. NOT a closure; NOT a clean refutation of a single Lean lemma (the cited lemmas are all true) -- it is a partially-correct insight with a refuted numerical core, suitable for a DISPROOF_LOG note on the magnitude/rate sub-claims. Probes are exact integer (big-int) for spreads/first-moment and exact enumeration over F_q for the small-n family distribution; n=64 family used gamma-sampling (noisy, not load-bearing).
